scope.objective: Independently test whether selected public official/exchange URLs actually return a small cross-class sample that could inform a future data-acquisition route.
out_of_scope: No U0 population construction or freeze.
No T2 derivation, product diligence, suitability conclusion, allocation, holding, order, or trade.
No historical replay, performance computation, or forecast.

method.access: Unauthenticated read-only HTTPS GET; generic browser user-agent; official-page Referer; no credentials, account, purchase, rate bypass, or external action.
method.success_definition: A same-day call returned HTTP 200 with a parseable or otherwise expected response body that was retained with a SHA-256 digest.
method.time_boundary: Local retrieval time is not source-side available_at. A queryable historic trade date is not evidence that the record, its exact version, or a decision-useful event was available at that historic time.

unconfirmed_or_failed_route_tests.result: TCP connection timed out after 8 seconds; curl exit 28; HTTP 0; no response body retained.
unconfirmed_or_failed_route_tests.inference_boundary: This environment-level failure proves neither the presence nor absence of a CFFEX product or lawful data route. It does not admit CFFEX data.

what_the_probe_supports: At the local capture time, selected SSE and SHFE public endpoints actually returned small machine-readable responses for multiple domestic asset classes.
In the sampled ETF endpoint, two non-overlapping begin/end windows returned the requested index windows. This is a route-discovery observation, not a declaration of full-history quality.
The sampled option endpoints separately returned a current contract snapshot and a retrospective date-filtered listing-adjustment result.
what_the_probe_does_not_support: A complete point-in-time archive, historical availability timestamps, immutable source versions, or a correction/revision chain.
Data rights for retention, normalization, formal replay, derived analysis, or independent review.
The ETF_PIT_EVENT_LEDGER, FUTURES_ACTUAL_CONTRACT_LEDGER, EXECUTION_AND_COST_LEDGER, or U0 population-and-derivation control required by the case.
Any return result, product admission, investment choice, suitability conclusion, allocation, holding, trade, order, or performance claim.

gate_effect.UR01: Open: public ETF price/master samples do not provide the complete PIT price-NAV-IOPV-event-status ledger or rights.
gate_effect.UR02: Open: one SHFE daily actual-contract file does not provide complete actual-contract lifecycle, PIT rules, or rights.
gate_effect.UR03: Open: no execution-and-cost ledger or authorized replay inputs were obtained.
gate_effect.U0: Open: current/filter query snapshots and individual-code samples do not form a frozen all-class population or a U0-to-T2 derivation audit.
gate_effect.UR04: Open: no signed input freeze, rulebook freeze, or formal replay run was created.
gate_effect.UR05: Open: no prospective paper reconciliation or independent execution/risk review was performed.
gate_effect.decision: The case remains q=0 and is not usable as an investment strategy.

next_safe_research_step: Use these URLs only as named discovery routes in a future written rights-and-delivery inquiry. Before any replay, obtain a contractual, immutable, PIT-aware package that covers the selected class, including available_at/vintage/revision evidence, complete population and event reconciliation, and an execution-and-cost ledger; then freeze U0, U0-to-T2 derivation, rulebook, and inputs before seeing results.
